summary: Built the revit-bridge Python engine that runs in a Cowork/claude.ai Linux sandbox (pip-installable, no Claude Code/local deps): validate_ifc.py (schema validation + full Revit-fidelity linter with Tier scoring and top-5 fixes), harden_ifc.py (Tier-1 rewriter: type merge/synthesis, pset dedupe to types, owner-history repair, phantom removal or clearance->IfcSpace, provable-box tessellation -> IfcExtrudedAreaSolid with recovered insertion point + yaw, containment repair; GlobalIds preserved; reopens with 0 schema errors), generate_ifc.py (deterministic spec->IFC4 generalising gen_ifc_min.py to the building schema PLUS an MEP `equipment` profile emitting shared types with IfcMappedItem instancing, typed psets, spaces), report.py (Tier-1/Tier-2 delivery markdown), plus requirements.txt, README.md, the electrical-room example spec (scores 100/100 Tier 1), a synthetic v1-defect fixture, and a 12-test pytest suite. On the real Design sample: score 31 (Tier 0) -> 89 after hardening, 10/11 products converted to extrusions (61 boxes), 4 shared types synthesised, geometry world-bboxes identical, all 11 GlobalIds preserved. Full repo test suite (37) passes.
key_findings: The saved sample samples/design-ifc/bs-area-e-electrical-room.ifc does NOT contain the two defects the brief expected: it has ZERO type objects (no IfcRelDefinesByType at all, all 11 elements untyped) and NO clearance/swing/helper or transparent solids. It DOES have: 11 products, 50 IfcTriangulatedFaceSet (100% tessellated), all-identity placements, single storey, no IfcSpace, and Voltage stored as IfcLabel. Tests assert the real defects on the sample and cover duplicate-type merging + phantom removal on a synthetic v1-defect fixture (tests/fixtures_ifc.py).

Tessellated geometry in the sample is fully recoverable: a connected-component + rectangular-prism test on the triangle soups proves 10 of 11 products decompose entirely into exact upright boxes (panels = 6 boxes incl. the 2-box strut backing, transformers = 7 boxes incl. 4-box louvres, room shell = 4 boxes); only the trapeze hangers (rods) stay tessellated. harden_ifc converts these to IfcExtrudedAreaSolid, sets each product's placement to the primary box base-centre with its yaw (recovering insertion points), retargets IfcStyledItems to keep materials, and kernel-verified world bounding boxes are byte-for-byte unchanged (max deviation < 2e-3 m).

validate_ifc.py scoring: real sample = 31.4/100 'Tier 0 (v1-like)'; hardened sample = 89/100 'Tier 1 (partial)' (trapeze still a blob); generated electrical-room = 100/100 'Tier 1' with 0% tessellation, 6 shared types (3 equipment via IfcRepresentationMap/IfcMappedItem + wall/slab/door types), 1 IfcSpace, clearances only as psets. Component weights: geometry 28, placements 20, typing 14, schema 8, phantoms 8, spatial 8, instancing 6, data 4, units 4.

generate_ifc.py is byte-deterministic (seeded GUIDs from a hash of the spec, fixed timestamps from project.issueDate, canonicalised set-ordered relationships, single unified owner history, spec-derived header filename); verified identical sha1 across 3 runs and covered by a pytest. Deterministic containment required replacing ifcopenshell.api.spatial.assign_container (set-ordered placement rewrites made entity ids vary).

ifcopenshell 0.8.5 gotchas found and worked around: IfcDoorType/IfcWindowType have mandatory OperationType/PartitioningType (schema error otherwise); the api spawns a new IfcOwnerHistory per operation once dates diverge (unified at the end); create_2pt_wall profiles are IfcIndexedPolyCurve, not IfcPolyline; validate(express_rules=True) needs pytest so the CLIs use schema-only validation to keep sandbox deps minimal.

The wave-1 spec/building.schema.json (additionalProperties:false) rejects the new example on exactly two keys: top-level `equipment` and `rooms[].psets`; proposed v0.2.0 additions are written in docs/inbox/cowork-engine.md (generator does not enforce the schema, so the example works today).

The generated file's kernel-verified geometry is correct: panels mount at 1.067 m at their spec positions (0.508x0.15x0.914 boxes), transformers respect rotationDeg 90 (footprint swaps to 0.51x0.61), the door opening voids its host wall (west wall volume 5.56 m3 vs 5.95 m3 for the identical un-cut east wall), and the space fills the 10.363x4.877x6.096 m room.
